result: GenesisHottHorns and GenesisHottModel compile under Lean 4.35.0 with the pinned Mathlib available through the read-only package junction. Neither module imports Mathlib. Every printed axiom list is a subset of {propext}; Classical.choice and Quot.sound do not occur. The horn statements are about the declared finite semi-simplicial set only. Genesis-determination of that set is not proved.
proof_boundary: This receipt records the build of lean4/GenesisHottHorns.lean and lean4/GenesisHottModel.lean. It does not change any DAG node status. The finite carrier is not an infinity-groupoid, not a univalent universe, and not an (infinity,1)-category. Those three names are prose imports in dag/derivations/independent/genesis_hott_horns.md.

lean_replay.library: GenesisHottHorns (lean_lib in lean4/lakefile.lean; not a default target)
lean_replay.build_directory: lean4/b (lakefile buildDir; removed after the run)
lean_replay.dependency_packages: read-only junction lean4/.lake/packages to the shared Mathlib v4.35.0 cache (removed after the run)
lean_replay.command: cd lean4 && lake build GenesisHottHorns && lake build GenesisHottModel
